

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("../data/nyc-stop-and-frisk/sqf-2024.csv")

df[df == "(null)"] = pd.NA
df[df == "Y"] = 1
df[df == "N"] = 0



cols = [
    "FRISKED_FLAG", 
    "SEARCHED_FLAG",
    "WEAPON_FOUND_FLAG",
    "SUSPECTS_ACTIONS_DECRIPTION_FLAG",
    "STOP_WAS_INITIATED",
    "SUSPECT_SEX", 
    "SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE", 
    "SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION",
    "DEMEANOR_OF_PERSON_STOPPED",
    'PHYSICAL_FORCE_CEW_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_DRAW_POINT_FIREARM_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_HANDCUFF_SUSPECT_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OC_SPRAY_USED_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OTHER_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_RESTRAINT_USED_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_WEAPON_IMPACT_FLAG',]


df = df[cols]

df["PHYSICAL_FORCE"] = df[[
    'PHYSICAL_FORCE_CEW_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_DRAW_POINT_FIREARM_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_HANDCUFF_SUSPECT_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OC_SPRAY_USED_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OTHER_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_RESTRAINT_USED_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_WEAPON_IMPACT_FLAG',]].max(axis=1)

df.drop(columns=[
    'PHYSICAL_FORCE_CEW_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_DRAW_POINT_FIREARM_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_HANDCUFF_SUSPECT_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OC_SPRAY_USED_FLAG', 'PHYSICAL_FORCE_OTHER_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_RESTRAINT_USED_FLAG',
       'PHYSICAL_FORCE_WEAPON_IMPACT_FLAG',], inplace=True)

df["PHYSICAL_FORCE"] = df["PHYSICAL_FORCE"].fillna(0)

df = df[df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"].notna()]

df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"] = df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"].astype("float")

```

## Likelihood of search? 

```{python}

y = df["SEARCHED_FLAG"].astype(int)


X = df.drop(columns=["SUSPECTS_ACTIONS_DECRIPTION_FLAG", "DEMEANOR_OF_PERSON_STOPPED", "SEARCHED_FLAG", "PHYSICAL_FORCE", "WEAPON_FOUND_FLAG", "FRISKED_FLAG"])

X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=False)


LM = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
LM.fit(X, y)


print(f"Base rate: {y.mean()}, Accuracy: {LM.score(X, y)}")

coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature": X.columns,
    "coefficient": LM.coef_[0]
})

coef_df = coef_df.sort_values(by="coefficient", ascending=False)

coef_df

```

## Likelihood of frisk?

```{python}
y = df["FRISKED_FLAG"].astype(int)

X = df.drop(columns=["SUSPECTS_ACTIONS_DECRIPTION_FLAG", "DEMEANOR_OF_PERSON_STOPPED", "SEARCHED_FLAG", "PHYSICAL_FORCE", "WEAPON_FOUND_FLAG", "FRISKED_FLAG"])
X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=False)

LM = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
LM.fit(X, y)

print(f"Base rate: {y.mean()}, Accuracy: {LM.score(X, y)}")

coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature": X.columns,
    "coefficient": LM.coef_[0]
})

coef_df = coef_df.sort_values(by="coefficient", ascending=False)
coef_df
```

## Physical Force? 

```{python}
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
df = df[df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"].notna()]

ix = df["FRISKED_FLAG"] + df["SEARCHED_FLAG"] >= 1 
df = df[ix]

y = df["PHYSICAL_FORCE"]


df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"] = df["SUSPECT_REPORTED_AGE"].astype("float")

X = df.drop(columns=["SUSPECTS_ACTIONS_DECRIPTION_FLAG", "DEMEANOR_OF_PERSON_STOPPED", "PHYSICAL_FORCE", "SEARCHED_FLAG", "FRISKED_FLAG"])

X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=True)


LM = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
LM.fit(X, y)

coef_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature": X.columns,
    "coefficient": LM.coef_[0]
})

coef_df = coef_df.sort_values(by="coefficient", ascending=False)

coef_df

y.mean()

LM.score(X, y)

```

```{python}
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

y.mean()

model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10)
model.fit(X, y)
model.score(X, y)

```
